# nonAdmin

<link-summary>Reports whether the current user is **not** a Workspace administrator.</link-summary>

<web-summary>nonAdmin() — Reports whether the current user is **not** a Workspace administrator. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/admin</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function nonAdmin(): boolean;
```

The negation of `isAdmin`, for the guard clause that leaves early. Because a failed lookup answers `false` there, it answers `true` here: an unavailable Admin SDK is treated as “not an administrator”, which is the safe reading.

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the active user is not an administrator.

## Examples

### Leaving early

```javascript
if (nonAdmin()) {
  return;
}
```
